direct_trigger: J2A positive motor error 6 -> J2 domain BRAKE -> GUI detects unhealthy hardware -> global session stop
operator_report: 拖动20°后J2发热且有声音，保持后卸力，GUI退出；当前竖直
inference: Manufacturer application identifies fault 6 as winding overtemperature. Hands-off/no-extra-payload holding failed with saturated integral and about 2 degrees of sag. Software model-to-wire conversion is consistent, but demand differs markedly from measured effort. Do not infer that a 37C ordinary temperature reading means the windings were cool.

mode_description.J2: dual motor common joint hold; integral correction limited to 1.5 Nm per rotor
mode_description.J6: DM-G6220 POS_VEL; no commanded torque feedforward in this mode
